request: meaningful action algorithm / ACT training and physical comparison
resource: existing local Mac environments only; no cloud allocation or paid compute

training.selection: development only; same complete episode never in train and development
training.second_model_gate: Review first complete training and physical outcomes before a second training; preserve prior model and failed trials. No silent hyperparameter or heldout adaptation.

regression_gate.purpose: new algorithm complete replay and failure-window path; not heldout

physical.qualification: Review repeated/new-case results before claiming success/reliability/speed. Failed or aborted times never count as completion improvements. Additional study needs a recorded evidence review and a finite new protocol.

preserve: source commit and immutable execution bundle
train/dev image and action hashes with source runs
checkpoint readback and actual ACT requests including discarded inference
all model/physics failures, stop reasons, original videos and independent referee output
publishing: Keep PR review and owner-gated main merge separate; trained model assets can be published as explicitly labeled experimental GitHub artifacts with provenance per prior user request.
